description.value: Golden Flour Bakery is a scratch bakery in Creston, BC that uses local ingredients and produces fresh baked goods daily in-store. Beyond pastries and elaborately decorated cakes and cookies, it also serves hot breakfast and lunch, making it a practical food stop for cyclists riding through the southern Kootenays. Free WiFi is available for customers dining in.

Hot food is explicitly confirmed by the website ('wide variety of hot breakfast and lunch options'); free WiFi is also mentioned, but no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling infrastructure are referenced anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
